alerts.title: NDM-producing Pseudomonas ST235 remains a major red flag
alerts.body: ST235 is a high-risk clone carrying NDM, which no avibactam combination inhibits. Suspect it in XDR Pseudomonas and send isolates for carbapenemase testing early.

alerts.title: Linezolid-resistant S. aureus is no longer theoretical
alerts.body: cfr, optrA and poxtA genes undo the assumption that linezolid always covers MRSA. Check susceptibility before relying on it in salvage regimens.

alerts.title: Community-onset OXA-48 stories matter because they change pretest thinking
alerts.body: OXA-48-like enzymes now appear in patients without recent hospital contact. Travel and prior healthcare history should raise suspicion before the full panel returns.

alerts.title: CRAB: sulbactam is the active ingredient
alerts.body: For carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter, sulbactam is the active component; IDSA 2024 favours high-dose sulbactam-based regimens over polymyxin-centred ones.

alerts.title: Newer oral agents change step-down plans
alerts.body: Omadacycline, linezolid and, in uncomplicated UTI and gonorrhoea, gepotidacin and zoliflodacin widen oral step-down choices. Check the label indication for each.
